mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dispatch_runtime_event (tenant_id, workitem_id, dispatch_id, agent_id, event_id, seq, event_type, step_id, step_key, step_order, step_name, message, error, detail_json, event_time) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{workitemId}, #{dispatchId}, #{agentId}, #{eventId}, #{seq}, #{eventType}, #{stepId}, #{stepKey}, #{stepOrder}, #{stepName}, #{message}, #{error}, #{detailJson}, #{eventTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE seq = VALUES(seq), event_type = VALUES(event_type), step_id = VALUES(step_id), step_key = VALUES(step_key), step_order = VALUES(step_order), step_name = VALUES(step_name), message = VALUES(message), error = VALUES(error), detail_json = CASE WHEN COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(VALUES(detail_json), '$.truncated')), 'false') = 'true' AND COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(detail_json, '$.truncated')), 'false') != 'true' THEN detail_json ELSE VALUES(detail_json) END, event_time = VALUES(event_time)

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT e.id, e.tenant_id, e.workitem_id, e.dispatch_id, e.agent_id, e.event_id, e.seq, e.event_type, e.step_id, e.step_key, e.step_order, e.step_name, e.message, e.error, CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'workflow.plan_applied' THEN e.detail_json ELSE NULL END AS detail_json, e.event_time, e.gmt_create FROM dispatch d STRAIGHT_JOIN dispatch_runtime_event e FORCE INDEX (idx_dispatch_event_type) ON e.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND e.dispatch_id = d.id WHERE d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND d.workitem_id = #{workitemId} AND d.source_type = 'WORKITEM' AND d.is_deleted = 0 AND (e.event_type LIKE 'step.%' OR e.event_type IN ('completion_requested', 'dispatch.completed', 'workflow.plan_applied', 'dispatch.failed')) UNION ALL
SELECT e.id, e.tenant_id, e.workitem_id, e.dispatch_id, e.agent_id, e.event_id, e.seq, e.event_type, e.step_id, e.step_key, e.step_order, e.step_name, e.message, e.error, CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'workflow.plan_applied' THEN e.detail_json ELSE NULL END AS detail_json, e.event_time, e.gmt_create FROM dispatch d STRAIGHT_JOIN dispatch_runtime_event e ON e.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND e.dispatch_id = d.id WHERE d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND d.workitem_id = #{workitemId} AND d.source_type = 'WORKITEM' AND d.is_deleted = 0 AND e.error IS NOT NULL AND NOT (e.event_type LIKE 'step.%' OR e.event_type IN ('completion_requested', 'dispatch.completed', 'workflow.plan_applied', 'dispatch.failed')) ) merged ORDER BY merged.id ASC

SELECT id, tenant_id, workitem_id, dispatch_id, agent_id, event_id, seq, event_type, step_id, step_key, step_order, step_name, message, error, CASE WHEN event_type = 'workflow.plan_applied' THEN detail_json ELSE NULL END AS detail_json, event_time, gmt_create FROM dispatch_runtime_event e JOIN ( SELECT MAX(e2.id) AS max_id FROM dispatch d JOIN dispatch_runtime_event e2 ON e2.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND e2.dispatch_id = d.id WHERE d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND d.workitem_id = #{workitemId} AND d.source_type = 'WORKITEM' AND d.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY e2.dispatch_id UNION SELECT MAX(e2.id) AS max_id FROM dispatch d JOIN dispatch_runtime_event e2 ON e2.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND e2.dispatch_id = d.id WHERE d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND d.workitem_id = #{workitemId} AND d.source_type = 'WORKITEM' AND d.is_deleted = 0 AND e2.event_type = 'agent.progress' GROUP BY e2.dispatch_id ) latest ON latest.max_id = e.id WHERE e.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND e.workitem_id = #{workitemId} ORDER BY e.id ASC
